baseProvenance.prompt: Remove all three large central gears, four raised lever platforms and all rails/connector plates; inpaint matching blue slate floor tiles, preserve walls peripheral containers torches.
baseProvenance.limitations: Concealed tile content is plausible inference. Tool changed overall dimensions and floor scale. No claim of recovered original hidden pixels; masked underlay needs visual QA. No hidden object completion yet.
